title: Grace notes on the fingerboard
description: An acciaccatura before a two-note chord, and a two-note grace run before the closing chord, on a guitar part in staffKind both. Grace digits are drawn small (0.6, matching the notation staff's GRACE_SCALE) so they read as an ornament rather than as part of the beat they decorate, and they sit in the rigid small columns the plan already reserved for them — which is why the tab and notation staves stay in column across a grace. The graces take no technique ordinal: they are never the origin or destination beat of a hammer-on, and numbering them would shift every technique after them.
